authoring: Direct conversational authorship; cross-group semantic comparison; no external LLM API and no generated-content script.
scope_convention: reference_section names directly retrieved primary passages, not whole-paper coverage. Failed requests and stored local patent reviews are separately identified.

evidence.read: Wolfenstein 1978 six-page original: Section III page 2372 equations 21-24 and Section IV summary. The earlier massless, flavor-changing neutral-current models are deliberately excluded.
evidence.support: In the stated standard neutral-current limit, the common neutral-current phase cancels from oscillations but electron-neutrino charged-current forward scattering changes propagation eigenstates and relative phase. Electron density enters the Hamiltonian and modifies the mixing and oscillation length.
evidence.limitation: No claim of universal enhancement, full modern three-flavor fitting, or direct experimental verification from this theoretical paper. The card does not claim the complete later adiabatic MSW density-sweep result.
evidence.nearest_comparison: Existing vacuum neutrino card expressly leaves matter propagation separate. Coherent nuclear recoil requires finite momentum transfer to the nucleus; this card concerns electron-selective forward refraction. Generic refraction changes ray direction at an index boundary rather than identifying a weak flavor-dependent Hamiltonian.

evidence.read: Evans et al. original 2023 theory: pages 2-4 Section II/III.A, Figure 2 and equation 1; results discussion around Figure 6 pages 13-14.
evidence.support: The electron induces positive surface charge. Subtracting its own Coulomb potential gives the induced potential; charging integration gives self-energy with a half factor. Adding that energy to contact potentials lowers computed barriers. The derivation assumes a homogeneous dielectric environment; specific geometric predictions are not generalized.
evidence.limitation: This is a continuum electrostatic mechanism, not an additional 2D material or metal-angle effect. Atomic-scale image-plane and interface-state corrections matter. No numerical enhancement factor is adopted.
evidence.nearest_comparison: Poole-Frenkel acts on an existing trap; here the carrier induces its own boundary response. Thermionic emission and tunneling describe crossing an already specified barrier. Dielectrophoresis acts on externally induced particle polarization in an imposed field gradient.

parent_source_check.read: Original Kublitski et al. 2021 Results, equation 5 and surrounding trap-generation discussion.
parent_source_check.support: Explicitly describes an external field reducing the escape energy of a pre-existing trapped carrier. It does not supply the self-induced conductor surface-charge pathway.

evidence.read: Niimi et al. 2012 original experiment/model, Introduction; page 3 dilute-impurity dependence; page 4 scattering phase-shift paragraph and equation 2.
evidence.quote: difference in these phase shifts comes from the SO interaction
evidence.support: Spin-orbit splitting changes impurity scattering phases and their interference, producing asymmetric spin-dependent scattering. The low-concentration scaling supports a skew contribution; concentrated samples depart from that regime.
evidence.limitation: The paper itself reports disagreement in sign with a different first-principles treatment and sensitivity to transport modeling. No universal sign, numerical angle, or complete quantitative agreement is asserted. Side jump is mentioned but not separately authored.
evidence.nearest_comparison: The intrinsic Berry card explicitly separates extrinsic asymmetric scattering. Elliott relaxation changes spin population through spin mixing, rather than identifying the antisymmetric directional collision probability.

parent_source_check.read: Sola et al. 2019 Discussion, paragraphs around equation 8 describing Pt inverse spin Hall conversion by a phenomenological Hall angle.
parent_source_check.support: The existing parent source uses a charge/spin conversion coefficient without selecting the impurity phase-shift mechanism. Its actual title is Experimental proof of the reciprocal relation between spin Peltier and spin Seebeck effects in a bulk YIG/Pt bilayer.

existing_card_supplement.decision: Do not count GMR as a new row; parent explicitly requested supplementation because existing linked patent review already names GMR.
existing_card_supplement.source_title: Valet and Fert · Theory of the perpendicular magnetoresistance in magnetic multilayers (1993)
existing_card_supplement.read: Original pages 7099-7100 Introduction and Boltzmann model assumptions; pages 7106-7107 Section III.C and Figure 3 caption.
existing_card_supplement.quote: both volume and interface spin-dependent scattering
existing_card_supplement.support: Relative magnetization alignment changes how spin-dependent bulk and interface resistances combine. The independent two-current limit requires layer thicknesses small relative to spin-diffusion lengths. The model retains spin flips outside that limit and does not justify independently adding isolated-interface resistances.
existing_card_supplement.suggested_boundary: Retain GMR microscopic transport and its spin-diffusion conditions as enrichment of existing magnetoresistance, with no separate count for geometry, interface material or sensor application.
